condition: Complete the bounded 20-node cold barrier benchmark, retain every OPEN leaf, observe original LP replay residual failures and/or material LP-objective to exact-certificate loss, and have at least 1200 s before the publication reserve.
experiment: Exactly one fresh best-bound unprocessed child LP. No new ROOT LP and no repeat of the same child domain.
comparison: Report original residual and exact certificate loss on the new child; different fixing domains do not support a paired speedup claim.
acceptance: Only OPTIMAL LP with independently recomputed original-array exact certificate updates a node LB; other outcomes remain OPEN.
